tasks.title: Confirm baseline project builds and tests
acceptance: The Xcode project builds for iOS Simulator
Configured automated tests pass or the absence of tests is documented
No project signing or capability settings are changed by the agent

tasks.title: Add grocery-list persistence foundation
acceptance: A SwiftData GroceryList model stores a stable identifier, trimmed non-empty name, creation date, and modification date.
CartsyneApp registers the GroceryList schema in the app ModelContainer without changing signing, capabilities, entitlements, or bundle identifiers.
Create, fetch, rename, and delete persistence behavior is covered by deterministic Swift Testing tests using an isolated in-memory ModelContainer.
Persistence errors are propagated to callers rather than silently ignored.
verification: Automated: GroceryList persistence tests pass for create, fetch, rename, and delete.

tasks.title: Build grocery-lists home and create flow
acceptance: The app launches directly into a NavigationStack titled Grocery Lists with no login, setup, dashboard, or onboarding screen.
An empty store shows Your grocery lists live here., Create a list to start shopping., and a working Create List action.

Create List presents a sheet whose name field receives keyboard focus, rejects empty or whitespace-only input, trims surrounding whitespace, and preserves entered text after a recoverable save failure.
Saving Weekly Groceries dismisses the sheet, immediately shows the new list in the populated home, and the list remains after app relaunch.
Populated lists are ordered by updatedAt descending with stable identifier order as the tie-breaker.
A persistence failure displays an understandable retryable error without exposing a raw Swift error.
The empty and populated states support VoiceOver, Light and Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and comfortable native hit targets.
verification: Automated: a focused UI test launches with an isolated empty store, creates Weekly Groceries, and verifies the row appears.
Manual: from an empty store, create Weekly Groceries, relaunch, and confirm it remains; check keyboard focus, Light and Dark Mode, VoiceOver labels, and a large accessibility text size.

tasks.title: Add grocery-list rename flow
acceptance: A discoverable native Edit action opens a sheet prefilled with the selected list name and focused name field.
Rename rejects empty or whitespace-only input, trims surrounding whitespace, updates updatedAt only after a successful save, and reorders the home consistently with updatedAt descending.
A successful rename appears immediately and persists after app relaunch.
A failed rename keeps the edit sheet and entered value available for retry and presents an understandable error.
Edit controls expose meaningful VoiceOver labels and remain usable with large Dynamic Type.
verification: Automated: persistence tests verify rename and updatedAt behavior; the home UI test verifies Weekly Groceries can be renamed to Household.
Manual: rename Weekly Groceries to Household, relaunch, and confirm the new name and ordering persist; verify empty-name validation and keyboard behavior.

tasks.title: Add confirmed grocery-list deletion
acceptance: A discoverable native destructive action asks Delete “<list name>”? before deleting an entire grocery list.
The confirmation explains This will also delete all items in this list. and offers explicit cancel and destructive confirmation actions.
Cancel leaves the list unchanged; confirmation removes only the selected list and persists after app relaunch.
A failed deletion leaves the persisted list recoverable in the UI and presents an understandable error.
Delete and confirmation controls communicate destructive intent to VoiceOver and remain usable with large Dynamic Type.
verification: Automated: persistence tests verify deletion affects only the selected list; a focused UI test verifies both cancel and confirmed-delete outcomes.
Manual: cancel deletion once, then confirm deletion, relaunch, and verify only the selected list is gone; check the confirmation in Light and Dark Mode with VoiceOver.
